Great turnout for yesterday's "Scaling Edge LLMs" webinar (1,140 registrants; 362 attendees). Quick handoff so SDRs can start outreach this afternoon. Attached is the attendee export and I dropped the replay and slide deck in Drive (links below).

2) Aisha: confirm MQL tags & list in HubSpot (I referenced a saved view below). If thresholds need adjusting, flag now.
3) Vivek: prepare a tailored email template for enterprise Hot accounts (mention Dedicated capacity + 1:1 capacity planning).

Target SLA: first outbound for Hot contacts within 72 hours. If any of you need me to jump on a call to prioritize accounts, I'm available 1–3pm PT today.
